storyCards.headline: Dreams I'Ll Never See: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Molly Hatchet's "Dreams I'Ll Never See" — original release 1985. Molly Hatchet is the debut studio album by American rock band Molly Hatchet.

It was released on September 1, 1978, by Epic Records.

The cover is a painting by Frank Frazetta entitled Death Dealer.

Molly Hatchet is an American rock band formed by guitarist Dave Hlubek in Jacksonville, Florida in 1971.

Song release — original 1985 chapter.
